mapper.select: SELECT fm.data_set_id, COUNT(*) AS managed_file_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fm.metadata_status = 'COMPLETED') AS footprint_file_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fm.metadata_status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING')) AS pending_metadata_file_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fm.metadata_status = 'FAILED') AS failed_metadata_file_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fm.metadata_status = 'NOT_APPLICABLE') AS not_applicable_file_count FROM ocean_gis.gis_file_meta fm WHERE fm.deleted = 0 AND fm.upload_status = 'READY' AND fm.data_set_id IN #{id} GROUP BY fm.data_set_id

SELECT data_set_id, id AS file_id, original_name AS file_name, representative_longitude AS longitude, representative_latitude AS latitude, representative_layer_key AS layer_key, representative_extent_kind AS extent_kind FROM ocean_gis.gis_file_meta WHERE deleted = 0 AND upload_status = 'READY' AND metadata_status = 'COMPLETED' AND data_set_id IN #{id} ORDER BY data_set_id, id
